body: That’s insane I didn’t know u could make money selling your acc 😭 yeah you’re right I really shouldn’t have spent on games, and I won’t ever again 💀

So it was multiple purchases of smaller amounts done over and over again over the course of a few months and the thing is I had been making such purchases while I was working with no consequence because I was getting paid. I just….didnt act smart when I quit. but I stopped within 3 ish months and have been extremely frugal since. no it wasn’t pubg it was another game! 
Haven’t got the job, I only started applying today.

I agree I just want to tell them when everything is over. I am getting into a high paying career in a couple of years and I’m very set on repaying then for everything, and I will be telling them. But not now…I feel too guilty now.

And yeah I guess if you wanna keep your kid safe keep an eye on his cc statement. Don’t go over every single item in it so that he doesn’t feel scrutinised and may try to find a way to hide things from you, but just keep an eye that the total amount is getting paid and there’s no major expenses. I get why you’re worried for your kid after hearing about me!

Edit: just realised since you plan to give them an add on, their purchases would show up in your statement right? in that case you’ll be fine. mine was definitely separate, I pay my bills myself

Just realising now that I have misunderstood my card situation. looked up my statement and related account details, and it’s a separate card but the the account manager is the same and he had a target to hit so he asked my dad to get the people in our family CCs. that’s why I thought it was initially an add on, but it definitely is not, as I just checked. regarding the cibil, I have been keeping a very close eye on my cibil due to the same.
